title: Unexplored Map Highlighter
description: A resourcepack that highlights areas of a map that haven't been explored yet.
body:
This is a pack meant to help you find parts of maps that you haven't mapped out yet!
When looking at a map that has a few pixels missing it is often easy to miss one or two spots, so I made this quickly to help myself map out a world by switching out the beige spots for a bright pink. This works on both handheld maps and placed maps.

Placed map:
![A comparison between vanilla, with the pack, and one that reveals which spots are not mapped, placed map](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63675b57641a7e645217cb537a40e0c5adb616be.png)

Held map:
![A comparison between vanilla, with the pack, and one that reveals which spots are not mapped, held map](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4596a5acc284fb20c9a00d92b7048bf8f0a52761.png)

This pack has some shared files with the resourcepack [simple item frames](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/simple-item-frames).
